Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the requirement or issue.

Change record: `quality/changes/<name>.json`
Risk: low / medium / high (the gate also classifies changed paths)
AI assistance: yes / no

- Components and design: responsibilities, assumptions, trust boundaries and compatibility.
- Dependencies: additions/removals/upgrades, reasons, sources and license/security implications.
- Verification: link actual CI decision, tests, coverage, scans and regression evidence; never claim unexecuted checks.
- Operations: configuration/migrations, rollout, rollback and remaining limitations.
- Human review: architecture/security reviewers use `docs/quality/04-review-templates.md` in an actual GitHub review.
- Exceptions: IDs and expiry, or none. An exception never erases the failed finding.

Do not paste credentials, source-book text or private runtime data into this PR.
